subject.title: improve(qa): align Telegram coverage with startup behavior

question: Should the parent QA profile-removal PR be accepted as the prerequisite architecture, after which this Telegram evidence PR can be rebased and reviewed as a standalone current-main change?
rationale: The child branch intentionally depends on an open architectural refactor, so only a maintainer can choose whether that prerequisite direction is accepted before evaluating the final merge-ready child behavior.

options.title: Land parent, then rebase child
options.body: Merge the profile-removal prerequisite, rebase this PR onto current main, and require exact-head QA Smoke and focused Telegram evidence before merge.

options.title: Reject the parent direction
options.body: Close or rework this child because its scenario-selection assumptions should not be introduced without the parent architecture.

recommendation.title: Land parent, then rebase child
recommendation.body: Merge the profile-removal prerequisite, rebase this PR onto current main, and require exact-head QA Smoke and focused Telegram evidence before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the active two-PR QA stack in the supplied history and can provide the rebased child proof after the maintainer chooses the parent direction.
